results.question: Which group had significant within-group vascular changes?
source_quotes: There was significant change within-yoga group in vascular function, BP and autonomic function, while no significant change within-BW group was observed.

results.question: Does this design isolate the effect of stretching alone?
source_quotes: INTERVENTIONS: Yoga group (n=30) was assigned for yoga training and brisk-walking (BW) group (n=30) for brisk-walk with stretching exercise for 1h in the morning for 6 days in a week for 12 weeks.

results.question: Were normal nonsmoking subjects included as a comparison group?
source_quotes: METHODS: The study population consisted of thirty type 2 diabetic male patients (15 smokers vs. 15 non-smokers) and 15 normal non-smoking subjects.

results.question: Was post-stretch reactive hyperemia reported in all subjects?
source_quotes: RESULTS: Following the stretch, post-stretch reactive hyperemia (PSRH) responses were found in all subjects. However, the diabetic non-smokers had relatively higher reactive blood flow than that of the diabetic smokers.
